review_state: upper C82-position hole strong photo match to D39.14/+5 V strip; lower tempting partner excluded as D39.9/LATCH_SIG
coordinate_system: original source-image pixels; approximate native-crop reads
assembly_context: The factory drawing places C82 left of C5 in the D39/D34 gap. The C5 candidate column is near front x3098. A C82 search column is therefore farther left, near x3040, but assembly outlines alone do not define holes.
front_screen: Native front crop (2760,2240)-(3110,2670) shows all seven D39 right-row contacts with notch at top. Counting top to bottom 14,13,12,11,10,9,8, the lower filled gap feature near (3040,2565) follows the sixth right-row contact, physical D39.9, by an exposed jog. Board source names D39.9 LATCH_SIG. The separate open annulus near (3040,2375) follows the fifth right-row contact D39.10/XTAL16M and was already excluded. The upper filled feature near (3040,2310) has no proved rail polarity.
solder_screen: D34-local map x_s=4084-0.960*x_f, y_s=-251+0.963*y_f sends front upper (3040,2310) to solder (1166,1974), within about 1 px of the observed joint. Native solder crop (1030,1810)-(1450,2070) shows this joint stem joined without a visible break to the broad horizontal strip above. A separate stem from that same strip reaches registered D39.14 near (1220,1950), the package +5 V pin. The lower front (3040,2565) projects near solder (1166,2219), but its same-hole identity and B.Cu destination remain unproved.
decision: Promote the upper front/solder hole pair as a strong C82-position +5 V candidate. Exclude lower front (3040,2565) as C82 ground because F.Cu reaches counted D39.9/LATCH_SIG. Keep C82 placement pending until a distinct GND partner is found and confirmed; do not pair the upper hole with the excluded lower signal feature.
next_inspection: Power off: confirm lower front feature (3040,2565) to D39.9 and to proposed solder hole (1166,2219), then test that hole against registered D39.9 (1220,2230). Confirm upper front (3040,2310) ↔ solder (1166,1974) ↔ D39.14/+5 V. Find a distinct ground partner for C82.
upper_plus5_observation: The upper solder joint near (1166,1974) and D39.14 near (1220,1950) are joined on exposed B.Cu by the same broad strip. The cross-face projection strongly matches front (3040,2310), so this is a strong candidate +5 V landing at the C82 assembly column, pending direct same-hole continuity. The D39.14 package-supply identity is independently source/model supported.
lower_solder_separation: Native solder crop (1090,2130)-(1290,2300) shows proposed counterpart near (1166,2219) soldered to a broad vertical strip, while registered D39.9 near (1220,2230) departs on a separate narrow eastbound B.Cu line. Brown clearance separates those two solder features locally. A front-side connection through the proposed hole remains possible, so this is not evidence of electrical isolation; it rules out a direct local B.Cu join and gives a precise continuity discriminator.
